import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); src=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
def cite(n):
 return f'observed-in-code gobreaker.go:{n} ("{src[n-1].strip()}").'
def event(id,source,desc,gate,n,unders=False,classification='external'):
 return dict(id=id,source=source,description=desc+'. '+cite(n),gate=gate,upstream_guards=[{'request caller':'General library has no caller validation. HTTP example constructs one breaker and checks Execute error at example/http_breaker.go:41 ("if err != nil {").','completion reporter':'Successful Allow is needed to obtain the function. No once-only or caller-identity guarantee. '+cite(267),'observer':'Wrapper forwards the selected receiver. No validation of intended identity. '+cite(254),'runtime clock observation':'Synchronous time sample during a locked operation. '+cite(280)}.get(source,'Custom implementation governs failure and liveness. No callback contract guarantees prompt return. '+cite(n))],undesired=unders,classification=classification)
rows,variants,pairs=json.loads(sys.argv[2])
events=[]
for id,source,desc,gate,n,coverage,*classification in rows:
 e=event(id,source,desc,gate,n,classification=classification[0] if classification else 'external')
 e['coverage']=dict(zip(["loss","delay","duplication","out-of-order","contradiction","commission","value"],['UV-'+x for x in coverage]))
 events.append(e)
for id,source,desc,n in variants:
 events.append(event('UV-'+id,source,desc,'Original operation gate; variant carries the timing, receiver or outcome described',n,True))
data=dict(events=events,pairs=[dict(id=f'P-{i:02}',first=a,second=b,entity=e) for i,(a,b,e) in enumerate(pairs,1)],remembrance='An outcome carries the generation captured at admission. '+cite(271)+' A generation advance clears the five counters. '+cite(364)+' '+cite(365)+' No per-request registry or queue is present. '+cite(128)+' A retained completion references its wrapper and generation, and the generation comparison happens after checking time. '+cite(272)+' '+cite(298)+' '+cite(299)+' Requests measures admitted requests in the current generation, with no per-report decrement. '+cite(56)+' Counter wrap and captured-reference lifetime require separate decisions.',lock_discipline='State, Counts, admission and accounting each acquire the same mutex. '+cite(207)+' '+cite(217)+' '+cite(277)+' '+cite(294)+' ReadyToTrip and OnStateChange are synchronous calls on locked paths. '+cite(326)+' '+cite(359)+' Execute calls the request and IsSuccessful between the admission and accounting lock sections. '+cite(242)+' '+cite(243)+' Name reads the immutable configured name without acquiring the mutex. '+cite(202)+' Callback-specific reentrancy and failure guarantees are absent from the contract.',notes='Request work, cancellation and downstream cleanup are owned by callers. There is no library shutdown API. Execute and Allow share an admission routine but are exposed through different constructed API forms.')
(root/'catalogue-fields.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
